svg.aria-label: L8 Memory dependence lineage: store sets, store-load pairs and memory renaming beside the M1 load-store unit
svg.text: L8 Memory dependence lineage: store sets, store-load pairs and memory renaming beside the M1 load-store unit
Left, three papers redrawn with their own numbers. Right, the M1 from the knowledge base: a 74-entry store-load pair predictor, zero-cycle loads, a late recheck and a 25-cycle flush.
How the lineage tag is meant
a load waits for the last fetched store of its set
stores in one set issue in order
load PC · store PC · V · dist
a mis-speculation records the store and load PCs
the load then waits on that store, and only that one
a load guesses the value a matching store left; the real load only checks
store and load share a base
load address prediction, on the M2
load value prediction, on the M3
a store PC and a load PC as a pair
a predicted load waits for its store
renaming a load to the stored value
renamed through the register, no value
a second check as the data returns
likely: structure matches field for field
